claim: The new palette gives ordinary links and dark-theme navigation insufficient text contrast, reducing accessibility for readers with low vision.
evidence: Light-theme links use #e8760a against the #faf9f7 body background (2.84:1 contrast). In dark mode, .navbar .nav-link uses --forge-smoke (#6b7280) against the header's #141a22 background (3.62:1) at 0.875rem. Both fall below 4.5:1 for normal-sized text.
